headline: WSN @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 3.97 at BOS 5.45, with a projected total of 9.42. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: WSN moved -0.50 runs while BOS moved +0.74, changing the projected margin by -1.24 runs. NRFI probability dropped -6.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Ranger Suarez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Caleb Durbin, Anthony Seigler, Keibert Ruiz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Romy Gonzalez, James Wood because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
